training_note: Best public source of campaign + timestamp structure; not victim sessions. Positive-only.
schema: canonical msg-v1 (see docs/REAL_DATA_STRATEGY.md); raw columns listed in 'raw_columns'; phishing_campaigns.csv: campaignID, objectID, number of messages, start/stop timestamp, message template (#URL/#OTP), urls

label_schema.canonical: all messages labelled scam (URL flagged by VirusTotal/APWG); no legitimate messages

paper: On SMS Phishing Tactics and Infrastructure. IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2024
pii_status: Destination numbers are public gateway numbers (not victims); message text unmasked (URLs, codes)
collection_method: Crawled public online SMS gateways; kept messages whose URLs VirusTotal/APWG marked as phishing; clustered into campaigns
geography: Messages received by public SMS gateway numbers; UK and US heavy, 81 Indian (+91) destinations
limitations: Header has 6 names but rows have 7 fields: pandas silently shifts columns; parse positionally
URL-reputation labels include gambling/marketing promotions (label noise)
Gateway numbers are not real victims: no replies, no payments, no outcomes
name: On SMS Phishing Tactics and Infrastructure — gateway messages and campaigns (IEEE S&P 2024)
source: Nahapetyan, Prasad, Childs, Oest, Ladwig, Kapravelos, Reaves (NC State / PayPal)
